ns2:course.label: Intro to Interpersonal Comm
ns2:course.description: Refine your communication skills in one-on-one conversations. Learn active listening, small talk, how to give good advice and emotional support, and conflict resolution. Students complete a semester-long skills project in which they reflect on and improve their own communication skills related to impression management, communication with family and friends, listening, small talk, and more. Course concepts apply to academic, professional, and personal interactions.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Social & Beh Sci - Soc Sci course.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: In Fall and Spring terms, students must register for one discussion and one lecture section.
